squad.requestsHint: Other NoCap servers that want in on your squad, and the ones you asked. Requests run out after 10 minutes.
squad.compare: Make sure these match what {name} shows on its own screen before you say yes.
squad.linkedHint: NoCap servers in your squad. Each one stays its own boss with its own sign-in; sharing stuff between them is coming later.
squad.linkedEmpty: No linked servers yet. Find one above and send it a link request.
squad.unlinkMsg: {name} drops out of your squad on both sides. You can send a new link request later.
squad.phonesHint: Phones with the NoCap OS app that asked to link, no code needed. Only say yes if the digits match the phone.
squad.phoneForOther: Wants to join {user}'s account, so only {user} can accept it
squad.phoneUnknown: Asked for {user}, but there's no account by that name. You can only pass on it.
